C0897.title: Threat Hunter 2022 API Security Research Report: Average Monthly Attacked APIs Exceed...
C0897.summary: The 2022 Threat Hunter report indicates that a large number of credential stuffing and account enumeration attacks targeting social platforms were monitored, with involvement from professional underground gangs. Some large social platforms suffered repeated attacks due to API vulnerabilities, leading to frequent account security incidents.
